title: La question qui débloque l'échange
titleEn: The question that moves the conversation forward
summary: A learner prepares for a community information call and gets a useful answer by asking about one missing detail.

sentences.fr: Marc voulait participer à une rencontre sur les possibilités de formation dans son quartier.
sentences.en: Marc wanted to attend a meeting about training options in his neighbourhood.

sentences.fr: L'annonce indiquait la date et l'adresse, mais ne précisait pas s'il fallait s'inscrire.
sentences.en: The notice gave the date and address, but did not say whether registration was required.

sentences.fr: Il a appelé l'organisatrice et lui a demandé si les personnes pouvaient venir sans réservation.
sentences.en: He called the organizer and asked whether people could attend without booking.

sentences.fr: Elle a répondu que l'inscription était conseillée, surtout pour recevoir les documents après la rencontre.
sentences.en: She replied that registration was recommended, especially for receiving the documents after the meeting.

sentences.fr: Marc a ensuite demandé si une personne qui travaillait tard pouvait obtenir un résumé par courriel.
sentences.en: Marc then asked whether someone who worked late could receive a summary by email.

sentences.fr: L'organisatrice a confirmé qu'elle enverrait le résumé le lendemain à toutes les personnes inscrites.
sentences.en: The organizer confirmed she would send the summary the next day to everyone who registered.

sentences.fr: Marc a répété la date, l'heure et la condition d'inscription avant de terminer l'appel.
sentences.en: Marc repeated the date, time and registration condition before ending the call.
sentences.note: Repeating key details at the end of a call is a practical way to catch a misunderstanding while there is still time to correct it.

quiz.prompt: What information was missing from the notice?
quiz.explain: The second sentence says the notice did not specify whether registration was needed.

quiz.prompt: Why did the organizer recommend registration?
options: Only registered people could ask questions
Registered people would receive the documents after the meeting
quiz.explain: The organizer linked registration to receiving the documents.

quiz.prompt: What did Marc do before ending the call?
options: Asked the organizer to change the neighbourhood
Repeated the date, time and registration condition
quiz.explain: The last sentence lists the details he repeated.
